text: `LifecycleCommand::Reset` (cmd_lifecycle.rs:144-159) rebuilds the kernel with empty `active_account` and intentionally nulls the shared slot, but does NOT touch `IdentityRuntime` — so `IdentityRuntime::active` survives as Some. The following `Start` → `restore_active_session` early-returns at session_persistence.rs:61 (`if identity.active_pubkey().is_some() { return }`), so it NEVER re-syncs the account into the rebuilt kernel. Result: kernel/slot stay None while identity thinks it's signed in — silent desync, no crash, no restart. Exactly the chirp#40 symptom. Minimal failing test attached to the issue.
